evals.prompt: I manage Florida DC. Which materials have significant forecast inventory or safety stock issues over the next 26 model weeks?
evals.expected_output: Defaults to Scenario 1 without asking, resolves model weeks, checks actual inventory/safety where available, distinguishes unmet demand and tracks complete coverage.

evals.prompt: Using the full attached HPE BOM PDF, which finished goods are affected by the material issues we just found in Florida?
evals.expected_output: Uses prior-read material shortlist without full forecast refresh, reads entire BOM, exact matches only, makes no unsupported build-unit claim.

evals.prompt: For the four flagged Florida materials in Scenario 1, check all other sites and pick the best transfer source, ideally the site with the most excess in the shortage week.
evals.expected_output: Rechecks relevant weeks, pages all donor sites, separates largest modeled excess from transferable/fastest feasible stock; does not run PO search.

evals.prompt: Without changing any orders, can we pull forward committed open purchase orders for those Florida materials by their first risk week?
evals.expected_output: Finds matched open committed PO lines with dates and quantities, flags stale dated lines, gives qualified expedite checks rather than changing orders; does not run donor search.

evals.prompt: Give me a full material-to-finished-good risk report for all stock sites for the next model year with transfer and PO options.
evals.expected_output: Defaults to Scenario 1 without asking, runs all branches for full report, tracks coverage and data gaps.

evals.prompt: Use Scenario 2 for Florida instead, just check the first four weeks for inventory below zero.
evals.expected_output: Explicit Scenario 2 overrides Scenario 1 default, no PO/BOM/donor analysis, checks 4 model weeks only.
